answer: Bindings are kept in pigment, verified in vertex, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, and therefore it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the lantern check. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 30 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
